### Overview
Perform GO enrichment (Biological Process, BP) on differentially expressed (DE) miRNA target genes across histology-specific contrasts.

### Load Required Packages

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(topGO)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
```

### Set directory paths

```{r dir paths}
root_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-mirna-go-enrichment")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# miRTarBase targets
mirTarBase_targets_file <- file.path(results_dir,
                                     "human-mirna-target-predictions-miRTarBase.tsv.gz")
mirTarBase_targets_df   <- read_tsv(mirTarBase_targets_file, col_types = cols())

# Histologies and controls
histologies <- c("ATRT", "DIPG or DMG", "EPN", "HGG", "LGG", "MB")
```

### GO Enrichment per Histology and Contrast

```{r go-enrichment, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
mirna_target_list    <- list()
mirna_target_go_list <- list()

# Precompute background once
all_entrez_ids <- keys(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype = "ENTREZID")
all_genes      <- select(org.Hs.eg.db,
                         keys    = all_entrez_ids,
                         columns = "SYMBOL",
                         keytype = "ENTREZID")

for (hist in histologies) {
  message("▶ Histology: ", hist)
  
  # Determine contrasts
  contrasts <- if (hist %in% c("ATRT", "HGG", "LGG")) {
    "healthyNormal"
  } else {
    c("healthyNormal", "paired")
  }
  
  # Read DE miRNA lists per contrast
  de_lists <- list()
  for (ctr in contrasts) {
    fname <- if (ctr == "paired") {
      glue("DESeq2_{hist}_paired_sig.csv")
    } else {
      glue("DESeq2_{hist}_vs_{ctr}_sig.csv")
    }
    path <- file.path(root_dir,
                      "analyses", "human-mirna-expression",
                      "results", fname)
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      message("   ✗ Missing file: ", fname)
      next
    }
    df <- read_csv(path, col_types = cols())
    de_lists[[ctr]] <- df %>%
      filter(str_detect(miRNA, "^hsa")) %>%
      pull(miRNA)
    message("   • ", ctr, ": ", length(de_lists[[ctr]]), " miRNAs")
  }
  
  # Find miRNAs shared across all contrasts
  shared <- Reduce(intersect, de_lists)
  message("   → Shared DE miRNAs: ", length(shared))
  if (length(shared) == 0) next
  
  # Run GO for each shared miRNA
  for (mirna in shared) {
    message("     – GO for ", mirna)
    mirna_target_list[[mirna]] <- mirTarBase_targets_df %>%
      filter(miRNA == mirna) %>%
      distinct(`Target Gene`) %>%
      pull(`Target Gene`)
    
    # Only proceed if at least 20 targets
    if (length(mirna_target_list[[mirna]]) >= 20) {
      
      # Binary vector for topGO
      target_gene_df <- all_genes %>%
        mutate(target_gene = if_else(
          SYMBOL %in% mirna_target_list[[mirna]],
          1L, 0L
        ))
      target_genes <- target_gene_df$target_gene
      names(target_genes) <- target_gene_df$SYMBOL
      
      GO_data <- new("topGOdata",
                     ontology  = "BP",
                     allGenes  = target_genes,
                     geneSel   = function(x) x == 1,
                     annot     = annFUN.org,
                     mapping   = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                     ID        = "symbol")
      
      # Fisher test + table
      result <- runTest(GO_data, algorithm="classic", statistic="fisher")
      go_tab <- GenTable(GO_data, classicFisher = result,
                         topNodes = length(usedGO(GO_data)),
                         numChar  = 100000) %>%
        mutate(fdr = p.adjust(as.numeric(classicFisher), method="BH")) %>%
        filter(fdr < 0.05)
      
      if (nrow(go_tab) > 0) {
        out_file <- glue("{mirna}-{hist}-shared-GO-BP_all.tsv")
        write_tsv(go_tab, file.path(results_dir, out_file))
        message("         ✓ Wrote ", nrow(go_tab), " terms to ", out_file)
      } else {
        message("         ✗ No significant GO terms for ", mirna)
      }
      
    } else {
      message("         ✗ Only ", length(mirna_target_list[[mirna]]),
              " targets; skipping ", mirna)
    }
  }
}
```
